ctiReport.title: Synthetic intrusion report (e2e fixture)
ctiReport.text: The intrusion began with spearphishing emails that carried a malicious Word attachment. Once opened, the document launched encoded PowerShell commands to stage the next payload. The operators created a scheduled task so the loader ran again at every logon. They then dumped LSASS process memory to recover credentials. Finally, the collected archives were exfiltrated over the existing command and control channel.
